name: null_test.k
smt:
; ================
; === Options: ===
; ================

(set-option :smt.macro-finder true)

; ======================
; === String Theory: ===
; ======================

; Z3 4.13.0+ requires explicit logic or theory declaration for strings
(set-logic ALL)

; ===========================
; === Built-in datatypes: ===
; ===========================

(define-sort Ref () Int)

(declare-datatypes (T1 T2) ((Tuple2 (mk-Tuple2 (_1 T1)(_2 T2)))))
(declare-datatypes (T1 T2 T3) ((Tuple3 (mk-Tuple3 (_1 T1)(_2 T2)(_3 T3)))))


; ===============================
; === User-defined datatypes: ===
; ===============================

(declare-datatypes () ((StringTest (mk-StringTest (s String)))))
(declare-datatypes () ((RefTest (mk-RefTest (ref Ref)))))
(declare-datatypes () ((TestSimple (mk-TestSimple (holder Ref)))))

; =============
; === Heap: ===
; =============

(declare-datatypes () ((Any
  (lift-StringTest (sel-StringTest StringTest))
  (lift-RefTest (sel-RefTest RefTest))
  (lift-TestSimple (sel-TestSimple TestSimple))
  null))
)

(declare-const heap (Array Ref Any))
(declare-const NULL$ String)
(declare-const NULL$Ref Ref)
(assert (= NULL$Ref (- 1)))

(define-fun deref ((ref Ref)) Any
  (select heap ref)
)

; ==========================================
; === Class specific is/deref-functions: ===
; ==========================================

(define-fun deref-is-StringTest ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-StringTest (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-StringTest ((this Ref)) StringTest
  (sel-StringTest (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-is-RefTest ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-RefTest (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-RefTest ((this Ref)) RefTest
  (sel-RefTest (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-is-TestSimple ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-TestSimple (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-TestSimple ((this Ref)) TestSimple
  (sel-TestSimple (deref this))
)

; ======================
; === Isa-functions: ===
; ======================

(define-fun deref-isa-StringTest ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-is-StringTest this)
)

(define-fun deref-isa-RefTest ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-is-RefTest this)
)

(define-fun deref-isa-TestSimple ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-is-TestSimple this)
)

; ================
; === Getters: ===
; ================

; ---------------------------------
;   Getters for class StringTest:
; ---------------------------------

; --- getters for StringTest.s: ---

(define-fun StringTest.s ((this Ref)) String
  (s (deref-StringTest this))
)

(define-fun StringTest!s ((this Ref)) String
  (s (deref-StringTest this))
)

; ------------------------------
;   Getters for class RefTest:
; ------------------------------

; --- getters for RefTest.ref: ---

(define-fun RefTest.ref ((this Ref)) Ref
  (ref (deref-RefTest this))
)

(define-fun RefTest!ref ((this Ref)) Ref
  (ref (deref-RefTest this))
)

; ---------------------------------
;   Getters for class TestSimple:
; ---------------------------------

; --- getters for TestSimple.holder: ---

(define-fun TestSimple!holder ((this Ref)) Ref
  (holder (deref-TestSimple this))
)

; ================
; === Methods: ===
; ================

; ---------------------------------
;   Methods for class StringTest:
; ---------------------------------

(define-fun StringTest.isNull ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (StringTest.s this) NULL$)
)

(define-fun StringTest!isNull ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (StringTest!s this) NULL$)
)

(define-fun StringTest.isNotNull ((this Ref)) Bool
  (not (= (StringTest.s this) NULL$))
)

(define-fun StringTest!isNotNull ((this Ref)) Bool
  (not (= (StringTest!s this) NULL$))
)

; ------------------------------
;   Methods for class RefTest:
; ------------------------------

(define-fun RefTest.isRefNull ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (RefTest.ref this) NULL$Ref)
)

(define-fun RefTest!isRefNull ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (RefTest!ref this) NULL$Ref)
)

; ===================
; === Invariants: ===
; ===================

; -----------------------------------
;   Invariant for class StringTest:
; -----------------------------------

; --- Constants: ---

(declare-const const-1-StringTest StringTest)
(declare-const const-2-StringTest StringTest)



; --------------------------------
;   Invariant for class RefTest:
; --------------------------------

; --- Constants: ---

(declare-const const-3-RefTest RefTest)

; --- Invariant 1: ---

(define-fun RefTest.inv1 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-isa-StringTest (RefTest!ref this))
)

(assert (! (RefTest.inv1 3) :named _xkassert0))



; -----------------------------------
;   Invariant for class TestSimple:
; -----------------------------------

; --- Constants: ---

(declare-const const-4-TestSimple TestSimple)

; --- Invariant 1: ---

(define-fun TestSimple.inv1 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-isa-StringTest (TestSimple!holder this))
)

(assert (! (TestSimple.inv1 4) :named _xkassert1))




; ======================
; === Generate heap: ===
; ======================

(assert
  (=
    heap
    (store(store(store(store
      ((as const (Array Ref Any)) null)
        1 (lift-StringTest const-1-StringTest))
        2 (lift-StringTest const-2-StringTest))
        3 (lift-RefTest const-3-RefTest))
        4 (lift-TestSimple const-4-TestSimple))
  )
)
smtModel:
(define-fun const-3-RefTest () RefTest
  (mk-RefTest 2))
(define-fun const-1-StringTest () StringTest
  (mk-StringTest "A"))
(define-fun const-4-TestSimple () TestSimple
  (mk-TestSimple 1))
(define-fun const-2-StringTest () StringTest
  (mk-StringTest ""))
(define-fun _xkassert0 () Bool
  (let ((a!1 (select heap (ref (sel-RefTest (select heap 3))))))
  (is-lift-StringTest a!1)))
(define-fun _xkassert1 () Bool
  (let ((a!1 (select heap (holder (sel-TestSimple (select heap 4))))))
  (is-lift-StringTest a!1)))
(define-fun NULL$Ref () Int
  (- 1))
(define-fun heap () (Array Int Any)
  (let ((a!1 (store (store ((as const (Array Int Any)) null)
                         1
                         (lift-StringTest (mk-StringTest "A")))
                  2
                  (lift-StringTest (mk-StringTest "")))))
  (store (store a!1 3 (lift-RefTest (mk-RefTest 2)))
         4
         (lift-TestSimple (mk-TestSimple 1)))))
